capabilities: Install statblock templates from GitHub repository or release URLs
Update installed templates from newer releases
Guide creators through publishing template releases on GitHub
disambiguation: Not an Obsidian Templates plugin; it installs Atlas VTT statblock template files, not note templates.
extras: Users must enable installed CSS snippets manually in Obsidian Settings → Appearance; templates are distributed as GitHub releases containing .atlastemplate and .css files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch Atlas VTT statblock templates and their CSS snippets from GitHub releases into the correct folders.

relations.evidence: install shared statblock templates and any associated CSS snippets into Obsidian and Atlas
paste the GitHub repository URL or the specific release URL containing the template

summary: Installer that pulls statblock templates and their CSS snippets from GitHub releases into Obsidian and Atlas VTT.
